abstract: Two hundred and eight cases of germ cell tumors of the testis were thoroughly studied. Fifty-one (24.5%) were embryonal carcinoma, 115 (55.3%) were seminoma, and 42 (20.2%) contained both embryonal carcinoma and seminoma. The average age of the patients with embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, and combined tumors was 27.6, 38.3, and 30.3 years. Furthermore, in the patients with combined tumors, those having a predominance of embryonal carcinoma had an average age of 28.3 years, while those having a predominance of seminoma had an average age of 33.4 years. This study supports the concept that the malignant potential of germ cells in younger patients is embryonal carcinoma, the malignant potential of germ cells in older patients is seminoma, and that in intermediate-aged patients the germ cells are capable of developing varying amounts of embryonal carcinoma and seminoma in the same tumor.
abstract_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍208例を詳細に検討した。51例(24.5%)が胎児性癌、115例(55.3%)がセミノーマ、42例(20.2%)が胎児性癌とセミノーマの両方を含んでいた。胎児性癌、セミノーマ、混合型の患者の平均年齢はそれぞれ27.6歳、38.3歳、30.3歳であった。混合型の患者のうち、胎児性癌が優位な群の平均年齢は28.3歳、セミノーマが優位な群の平均年齢は33.4歳であった。本研究は、若年患者の胚細胞の悪性潜在能は胎児性癌であり、高齢患者ではセミノーマであり、中間年齢の患者では同一腫瘍内に胎児性癌とセミノーマを様々な割合で生じうるという考えを支持する。
